2026年11月6日 07:45

Doomsday at the Dacha (Chekhov-style)

A cardboard apocalypse mushroom, with visible seams and props, looms over a dacha garden. Beside it sit a samovar, teacups, a plaid blanket, and a forgotten book. A faceless figure reads a newspaper on a chair. Above everything, a translucent sky traces the outline of a brain, as if dreaming this whole dacha apocalypse. It all looks like a stage production: painted scenery, screens, and a curtain.

Mood: irony, faint sadness, and a weary "here we go again."
